notes.title: Demo coming to Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Hello! This is our first update on Steam. Development updates have been happening over at [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tohriv/beyond-r-rule-ripper-evolving-death-game-visual-novel/posts"]Kickstarter [/url]so far, but the game is almost ready for release, so it's time to start talking here.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll keep it brief. The [b]Steam demo will finally release this September[/b], followed by our participation in Steam's Next Fest starting [b]October 13[/b], and then the game's release in [b]November[/b]! No exact dates for the demo and release yet, but they will be announced during August.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141087/a52fa4ecfa6e672068567a9fd35339495e12fd46.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The game has been fully playable for a few months now, only missing a handful of songs and some visuals that will be ready for the demo, so we've been testing and fixing bugs to make sure that it's as good as possible. If you haven't tried previous versions of it, the demo covers the first three chapters of the final game, about [b]8 FREE hours worth of content[/b]. And if you are familiar with the old demo, don't worry, there's been tons of improvements and changes since then.[/p][p][/p][p]Even better, you'll be able to [b]keep your progress from the demo to the full game[/b], even Steam Achievements. No need to replay anything.[/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist the game if you haven't already and see you next month![/p]
